cd "/home/cesar/papers/artifact-lifecycle-lab/artifact-lifecycle-lab/scratch/rq5_4b11e310c1625b56_C" && cat > conftest.py <<'EOF'
# Exclude VS Code Copilot extension *simulation fixtures* from pytest collection.
#
# These directories are test DATA for the TypeScript extension's simulation
# harness, not Python tests meant to run in this repository's pytest. Each
# fixture assumes its own directory as the project root (e.g. `from src.ex ...`,
# `from mmath ...`), so collecting them from the repository root raises
# ModuleNotFoundError during import. Ignore them so `pytest` collects cleanly.
collect_ignore_glob = [
    "extensions/copilot/test/simulation/fixtures/tests/py-pyproject-toml",
    "extensions/copilot/test/simulation/fixtures/tests/py_start_test",
    "extensions/copilot/test/simulation/fixtures/tests/py_end_test",
]
EOF
timeout 120 pytest 2>&1 | tail -12; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
